subject.title: fix(slack): repeated external menus grow gateway memory

question: What should a Slack user experience when a still-visible external menu is evicted solely because the bounded store is full?
rationale: The branch introduces a new user-visible overload contract that source tests cannot choose safely: silent empty options, a recoverable refresh, or another explicit response.

options.title: Require recoverable eviction behavior
options.body: Preserve the memory cap but have the options path regenerate or clearly recover a live menu that was evicted before its TTL.

options.title: Accept empty options at capacity
options.body: Keep the current least-recently-used eviction behavior and explicitly accept that overloaded live menus can return no choices.

recommendation.title: Require recoverable eviction behavior
recommendation.body: Preserve the memory cap but have the options path regenerate or clearly recover a live menu that was evicted before its TTL.

likelyOwner.reason: No individual Slack feature-history owner could be established from the available review evidence.
